text:
Alex Nguyen: Heads-up — ACME reported that their embeddings suddenly started coming back as length=1024 after we applied a pinned-model bump for them this morning. They were on 1536 earlier. Error surfaced in their indexer: 'vector size mismatch'.

Priya Patel: :eyes: Which pinned model did we roll for them?

Alex Nguyen: They had pinned 'redwood-embed-large-v1' -> the ops console shows we rolled the commit to 'redwood-embed-large-v1@2026-11-02' around 09:12 UTC to pick up perf fixes.

Samir Rao: Is it possible the model variant switched to a quantized artifact with shorter output? Any release notes that change dim?

Meghan O'Leary: I pulled the model manifest — the new artifact uses a different tokenizer config? unlikely but checking. Also ACME says this started when they hit a batched endpoint.

Alex Nguyen: Pasted the sample response they sent: 
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "redwood-embed-large-v1@2026-11-02",
  "input": ["doc1","doc2","doc3"],
  "batch_size": 3
}

200 OK
{
  "data": [
    {"embedding": [0.001, 0.002, ..., <1024 floats>], "index": 0},
    {"embedding": [0.003, ... <1024 floats>], "index": 1},
    {"embedding": [0.0005, ... <1024 floats>], "index": 2}
  ],
  "meta": {"vector_length": 1024}
}
```

Priya Patel: Thanks. Can you ask them for a non-batched single input response to see if batch vs single differs? Also get the model string from the response headers if possible.

Alex Nguyen: ACME ran single input. Single input returns 1536 as expected. So batching seems to be triggering shorter outputs. They included a trace id: trace-0a1b2c3d.

Samir Rao: That's weird — suggests batching logic or KV cache alignment issue where embeddings path picks a fallback smaller model for batched paths. Will check routing logs.

infra-bot: Deploy event: pinned-update redwood-embed-large-v1@2026-11-02 applied to customer ACME (acct: acme-prod) at 2026-11-02T09:12:31Z.

Meghan O'Leary: I pulled the router logs for trace-0a1b2c3d — we routed 3 tokens to node pool 'embed-batch-eu-2'. Node reported model artifact id 'embed-large-v1:artifact-20261102-A' for batched requests and 'embed-large-v1:artifact-20261020-B' for single requests.

Priya Patel: So two artifacts both under same pinned label? That implies our pinned label mapping is inconsistent across pools. Possibly a race during the pin rollout.

Samir Rao: Repro plan: 1) Recreate pin mapping locally 2) Send batched and single requests to particular pool via forced routing header (X-Redwood-Prefer-Pool). 3) Compare vector lengths + artifact ids. I can run now.

Alex Nguyen: ACME needs either a rollback or a workaround. Their downstream indexer refuses vectors that are not 1536, causing job failures and billing noise.

Samir Rao: Running step 2 now:
```
# reproduce
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "X-Redwood-Prefer-Pool: embed-batch-eu-2" -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-large-v1@2026-11-02","input":["a"]}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
```
Result: vector_length=1024.
Then:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "X-Redwood-Prefer-Pool: embed-single-eu-1" -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-large-v1@2026-11-02","input":"a"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
```
Result: vector_length=1536.
```

Meghan O'Leary: Confirmed. This is a rollout bug where artifact mapping for the pinned label wasn't atomically updated across every pool — batch pool got a different artifact (likely an intermediate with a different embedding head).

Priya Patel: Impact: customers with pinned labels and mixed routing (batch vs single pool) may see vector size inconsistencies. Severity: P1 for affected customers.

Alex Nguyen: ACME wants immediate rollback on their account. Can ops do a targeted rollback to artifact-20261020-B on embed-batch-eu-2 for acme-prod?

deploy-bot: Rollback request received for acct acme-prod on pool embed-batch-eu-2 to artifact-20261020-B. Starting targeted rollback.

infra-bot: Targeted rollback completed on embed-batch-eu-2 for acct acme-prod at 2026-11-02T09:34:05Z.

Samir Rao: After rollback I re-ran the batched request against that pool. Result: vector_length=1536. Verified with a 10-request sample.

Alex Nguyen: Sent note to ACME with mitigation (they can also set batch_size=1 or pin to specific artifact id), they prefer rollback.

Meghan O'Leary: Next steps: 1) Add an invariant check in the pin-controller that prevents publishing pins where 'embedding_dim' differs across candidate artifacts. 2) Add a canary gate for pinned updates that validates vector_length on both batch and single pools before flipping. 3) Run an account-level scan for other customers with mixed-pool routing and recent pin updates.

Priya Patel: I'll create the follow-up tickets and tag SRE/runtime. Recommend retro and a short customer-facing RCA.

Samir Rao: Quick notes on reproducer for eng-runtime: sometimes the artifact build pipeline can produce variant artifacts if a customeval job changes the head post-build. We need to freeze head metadata at build time.

Alex Nguyen: ACME asked for a billing credit for failed index runs. Support: please draft a credit estimate, include CPU/GPU and engineering time.

Meghan O'Leary: Drafted credit calc: 8 failed index jobs * 1.5 compute-hrs each -> 12 compute-hrs + support time = X. Sending PR to billing leads.

Priya Patel: Created tickets: RW-6721 (pin-controller invariant), RW-6722 (canary vector_length validation), RW-6723 (account scan & customer outreach). Assigning to runtime + SRE.

Alex Nguyen: Thanks everyone. Labeling this thread to follow-up. :thumbsup:

Meghan O'Leary: FYI leaving a snippet for the postmortem: 
```
Root cause: Non-atomic pin label propagation led to mixed artifact mapping across pool types; an intermediate artifact had a different embedding head dimension.
Corrective actions: targeted rollback, pin-controller invariant, canary validation, build pipeline freeze of embedding-head metadata.
```

Samir Rao: I'll add the repro script to the runtime repo and link RW-6721.

Alex Nguyen: Closing handoff to Priya for customer comms. Last note: monitoring alert created for vector_length drift on pinned models.

infra-bot: Alert created: embedding_dim_drift (threshold: any deviation from pinned artifact vector_length) on pinned model namespace.

Priya Patel: I'll escalate to account execs and prepare the RCA draft.

Meghan O'Leary: :thumbsup:
